show.description:
Priya Sharma’s life shatters when she learns she can never become a mother after three months and catches her boyfriend cheating on her with her best friend. Humiliated, she impulsively vows to marry within a week and become pregnant within three months.

Meanwhile, businessman Nitin Malhotra is under pressure to marry and produce an heir or lose his family empire. To solve their problems, Nitin proposes a three-month contract marriage to Priya
